headline: Public hearings on special permits for Sweetgreen and CAVA at 96 Tower Road lead the council docket.
summary: The council will hold public hearings on special permit applications for Sweetgreen Boston, LLC and CAVA Group, Inc. at 96 Tower Road. It will also consider mayoral requests including appointments, a $120,000 vehicle appropriation, a $462,755 loan authorization, grant acceptances, and committee recommendations on CPA funding, fuel storage licenses, and other permits.

Public hearing: Special Permit application at 96 Tower Road for CAVA Group (Recessed from 8/3/26)
Confirmation of Richard Pizzi, Jr. as permanent member of the Waltham Council on Aging

Adoption of amendment to compensation ordinance for election personnel costs

Acceptance of $9,000 EECBG grant funds for EV Chargers in public parking lots
